scientific_integrity: The Student-bridge representation, endpoint Student laws, and balanced chi-square collapse are treated as prior facts. The claimed contribution is only the sharp global central-coverage envelope over the nuisance variance ratio and its prediction-powered interpretation. The direct source lists MSC 62E15 first among its classifications.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for two independent Gaussian samples with positive variances, unbiased sample variances, a fixed predictor, and the normal-critical-value mean interval. The lower endpoint is an infimum when both variances must stay strictly positive.
title: Sharp Gaussian coverage envelope for the prediction-powered mean interval
